title: 日常对话　Part 1 · 练习
goal: 从日常咨询对话中记录准确的表单信息。

points.label: 区分原安排与最终确认
准确记录姓名与地址拼写

lines.text: Good morning. I would like to register for one of the weekend pottery courses advertised at the community centre. Could you tell me a little about the arrangements before I give you my details?
Of course. We have a beginner group on Saturdays and another on Sundays. Both meet in the same studio, and all the basic equipment is included in the course fee.
The Saturday group would suit me. I first thought I could start on the twelfth, but I have an appointment that morning. Is there still a place for the nineteenth?
Yes, there is one place left on the nineteenth. I'll put that date down. May I take your surname, please?
It is Merrin, spelled M E double R I N. My sister has a different spelling, so I always make sure people have the right one.
Thank you. And which street do you live on? We send the joining information by post as well as by email, because it includes a map of the building.
I live on Willow Street. There is also a Willow Road across town, so please make sure you write Street. My house number is fourteen.
I've got that. The course costs eighty pounds in total, including materials. We ask for a deposit of twenty pounds when you book; the rest is due on the first day.
That is fine. Is there anything I should bring? I have an apron at home, but I do not own any tools. I would prefer not to buy equipment until I know whether I enjoy the course.
An apron is useful, and please bring a towel as well. We provide the tools. Your class starts at ten, and reception opens half an hour earlier. I'll send your confirmation today.

lines.text: Hello. I am looking for somewhere to store a bicycle near the railway station. I travel to work by train, and leaving the bicycle outside all day is not very convenient.
We have a secure cycle store beside the station. Members receive a key card, so they can enter whenever the trains are running. Would you like me to register you?
Yes, please. I could begin on Monday, although I shall be away then. Actually, could the membership start on Tuesday instead? I would rather not pay for a day I cannot use.
Certainly. I'll record Tuesday as your starting day. First I need your surname for the membership card and the receipt. Could you spell it for me?
It's Halden, H A L D E N. My first name is Sam. Do you need my home address as well, or is an email address enough?
We need your home address for our records, even if you choose to receive the receipt by email. You can change the address later if you move.
The street is Beech Avenue, with double E in Beech. My building is number nine. I would like the receipt by email, please, if that is possible.
Yes, that's fine. The monthly charge is twelve pounds, and there is a separate refundable card deposit of five pounds. You get the deposit back when you return the card.
That sounds reasonable. I sometimes have a bag attached to the bicycle. Can I leave it there overnight, or does everything have to be removed at the end of the day?
Please take the bag with you. You may leave a helmet on the bicycle, though. I'll send the receipt now, and you can collect your card from the station office.
